description:
Pilot Ji Yoon-Woo has a passionate lover, Choi Jun-Won, who is four years younger than him. One day, waiting for Yoon-Woo when he returned home after finishing a flight was Jun-Won, who had unexpectedly turned out to be a kidnapper. “Don’t move.” A low, deep voice whispered earnestly in his ear. “Co-pilot Ji Yoon-Woo, you’d better stay still.” The voice he wanted to hear more than anyone else. That familiar voice threatened with unfamiliar words. 

*“How does it feel to be searched so deep inside?”
“Haa, ha. Stop…”
“It’s not confirmed yet, so please cooperate, Captain.”*

A sweet and energetic sex play between Co-pilot Ji Yoon-Woo and Choi Jun-Won, an airport counter-terrorism task force police officer.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

*Note: Part of Haewadal Studio's Saegya Danpyeonseon (색야 단편선) Collection.*
